title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Claim Filing Policy
content:
This policy governs the first claim Halverson Clinical Laboratories files for an order with a coverage held under **Insurance Coverage & Claims**.

## Clauses

1. **One claim per order per coverage.** The laboratory files one claim per order per coverage, the payer class's claim-submission lag in business days after the final report, for the order's list price total.
2. **Active coverage.** A claim can be filed only on a coverage that is active.
3. **Filing limit.** The claim must reach the payer no later than the payer class's filing limit in calendar days after the date of service.
4. **Order content.** A claim is filed only when the order carries diagnosis codes and, where the payer class requires prior authorization, an approved authorization collected within the payer class's authorization validity period of its approval.
5. **Re-verification.** A coverage whose last verified date is older than the payer class's re-verification span before the date of service is re-verified first.
6. **No second first claim.** A claim already filed for the same order and coverage is never filed again as a new claim; changes go through a corrected claim.
7. **Who files.** The laboratory files with every payer class for which it files claims on the patient's behalf, whatever the laboratory's network status with that payer class.
8. **Who is paid.** Where the payer class accepts assignment, the payer pays the laboratory. Where it does not, the payer sends its payment to the patient, no payer payment is recorded on the claim, and the patient is assigned the out-of-network balance under the adjudication rule.
9. **Adjudication.** A clean claim is normally adjudicated within the payer class's expected adjudication period in calendar days of filing; the payer's allowed amount is expected to be the payer class's expected percent of its fee schedule basis, but the remittance governs.
10. **Edits.** A frequency denial (CO-151) can arise only where the payer class applies test frequency edits, and a medical-necessity denial (CO-50) only where it applies medical-necessity edits.

## Clause 2 and clause 3 as conditions

| Condition | Read from | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Coverage active | The status on the record of the coverage the claim is filed with | The status is active |
| Filing limit | The collection date of the order billed (the date of service) | The filing date is no later than the last day of the limit |

**Counting the filing limit.** The filing limit counts calendar days with the collection date as day 0, and a claim filed on the last day is timely.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, Commercial In-Network Plan, filing limit 180 calendar days)

| Collection date (day 0) | Filing date | Day | Timely? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 January 2026 | 9 July 2026 | 180 | Yes — filed on the last day |
| 10 January 2026 | 10 July 2026 | 181 | No |

## Points of judgement

- *Two coverages, one order.* Clause 1 allows one claim for that order with each coverage; it never allows a second new claim with the same coverage.
- *A coverage pending verification.* It is not active, so clause 2 is not met.
